prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic minimalist monochrome elevator mirror selfie.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman in a dark oversized coat and black knit hat with cat ears, loose hair falling down her back, holding a black smartphone.
prompt.composition_elements: Profile-oriented mirror selfie in a matte-metal elevator, phone and hands in shallow focus, graphite and grey steel environment, calm posture, and soft shadows.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused neutral light, cool black-graphite-grey palette, slight film grain, quiet moody aesthetic.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 3:2 vertical composition, realistic 4K detail, shallow depth of field on phone and hands, natural hair and fabric texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic minimalist monochrome profile selfie of an approved adult woman wearing a dark oversized coat and a black knit hat with cat ears, her hair falling loosely down her back. She holds a black smartphone while taking a picture of herself in an elevator mirror with a matte metal surface. Use soft diffused lighting, a calm cool black, graphite, and grey-steel palette, slight film grain, shallow depth of field on phone and hands, detailed fabric and hair texture, 3:2 vertical composition, realistic 4K style, and soft shadows.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, colorful clutter, harsh flash, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, hat, coat, phone, elevator, monochrome palette, and composition; replace identity or cat-ear design with an approved alternative when needed. No typography or logo is required.
